title.zh: 阿肯色州起诉Kalshi，指控其经营非法赌博平台
title.en: Arkansas sues Kalshi over alleged illegal gambling platform

current_state.zh: Arkansas Attorney General Tim Griffin sued Kalshi for allegedly operating an illegal, unregulated gambling platform in violation of the state's Deceptive Trade Practices Act, seeking restitution, penalties, taxes and an injunction, making Arkansas the latest of several states — alongside New York, Michigan, Kentucky and Utah — to take prediction markets to court as the CFTC defends its jurisdiction.

updates.what_changed_zh: Arkansas Attorney General Tim Griffin sued KalshiEX LLC and Kalshi Inc., alleging the prediction market operates an unlicensed illegal gambling platform, offers real-money sports and entertainment betting to users including 18-year-olds, and violates state deceptive trade practices law, while seeking damages, fines, taxes, and an injunction.
